scope_assessment.geographic_institutional_scope: City-owned Albuquerque International Sunport and its airfield, terminal, landside and capital-planning system
scope_assessment.specific_albuquerque_connection: Direct master planning for a City-owned airport, including local facility alternatives, airport access, environmental constraints, sustainability objectives and capital investment.
scope_assessment.abqinfo_public_information_value: Explains the basis and alternatives for long-term public airport infrastructure and spending rather than generic aviation context or airline travel information.
scope_assessment.general_context_exclusion_test: The actual local forecasts, facility requirements, alternatives and recommended capital phases establish substantive Albuquerque information independent of official hosting or statewide airport relevance.
scope_assessment.substantive_rationale: This comprehensive City facility plan directly governs understanding of Albuquerque airport development, access and public investment. Its detailed local planning analysis supplies substantial durable policy and infrastructure value.

quality_assessment.document_function: Complete sustainability-led airport facility master plan with technical and capital implementation chapters.

quality_assessment.durable_public_usefulness: Documents the City's long-range facility and investment framework, including choices and reasons, not merely construction contacts or a project-status paragraph.
